chunks: But God knows what they harbour in their breasts.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God's knowledge of hidden thoughts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of *Ilm al-Ghayb* (Knowledge of the Unseen) as a divine attribute, highlighting that Allah’s awareness extends beyond mere observation to the deepest recesses of the heart (*batin*). It serves as a spiritual reminder for believers to maintain sincerity (*ikhlas*) in their deeds, knowing that their inner intentions are fully exposed to the All-Knowing. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on the unity of outward action and inward conviction in the path to righteousness.
